admission.justification: The honest-entry family needs the catalogue and summary to reject unusable comparison operands in the same order so their available subjects and displayed counts cannot disagree about whether the pair was read.

applicability: The subject catalogue (list_knowledge_review_entries) and the changed-intent summary (intent_summary_of) for one resolved review pair.
conditions: The pair is resolved from canonical task context by the reviewer's resolution.
exclusions: The per-subject review composition's own refusals (compose_review).
statement: The subject catalogue and the changed-intent summary refuse a resolved pair by one rule in one order: an unavailable knowledge side, closed-leaf record absence, an absent half, an unreadable half, then an unreadable candidate receipt.
